Zonal statistics with coverage diagnostics

Source: R/extract.R
ntl_aggregate.Rd

Summarises a (masked) nighttime lights raster over polygons using exact pixel coverage fractions (exactextractr), and reports how much of each unit was actually observed.

Usage

ntl_aggregate(x, units, id_col = NULL)

Arguments

x

A SpatRaster with a value layer and optionally masked and nobs layers (see ntl_mask()).

units

Polygons: sf or SpatVector.

id_col

Column of units with unique identifiers. If NULL, row numbers are used and the output column is called unit_id.

Value

A data frame with one row per unit:

ntl_sum

Sum of lights over observed pixels (coverage-weighted). NA when nothing was observed, so "dark" (0) and "unobserved" (NA) stay distinct.

ntl_sum_adj

ntl_sum / share_valid: the sum scaled up to the full unit, assuming unobserved pixels resemble observed ones.

ntl_mean

Mean radiance of observed pixels.

share_valid

Share of the unit's pixels with a valid value.

share_masked

Share removed by ntl_mask() rules.

mean_obs

Mean number of cloud-free observations per pixel.

n_pixels

Number of pixels covering the unit (fractional).

Examples

ex <- ntl_example()
m <- ntl_files(ex$dir, "eog_vnl_monthly")
r <- ntl_read(m, period = "2022-06", series = "eog_vnl_monthly_npp")
r <- ntl_mask(r)
ntl_aggregate(r, ex$units_old, id_col = "district")
#>   district   ntl_sum ntl_sum_adj  ntl_mean share_valid share_masked mean_obs
#> 1       D1        NA          NA        NA           0            0        0
#> 2       D2        NA          NA        NA           0            0        0
#> 3       D3        NA          NA        NA           0            0        0
#> 4       D4  773.5295    773.5295 0.3223040           1            0        8
#> 5       D5 1734.0659   1734.0659 0.7225275           1            0        8
#> 6       D6 5722.8332   5722.8332 2.3845138           1            0        8
#>   n_pixels
#> 1     2400
#> 2     2400
#> 3     2400
#> 4     2400
#> 5     2400
#> 6     2400
